{"dialogue": "Maya: heyy still good for today?
Me: yess I'm counting down to pizza lol
Maya: same, my stomach already decided
Maya: heads up tho I'm running like 5 mins late for our 1pm at Rosa's
Me: oh totally fine, no rush at all
Maya: laundry took over my life and now I can't find my other shoe
Me: lol classic friday
Maya: right?? wfh problems
Me: I'm still stuck in office hell but I can slip out in a bit
Maya: how's your morning been?
Me: endless emails, I barely got anything real done
Maya: ugh same, I had like 3 calls that could've been texts
Me: literally always
Maya: did you end up watering your plants?
Me: I did yesterday and they already look less dramatic
Maya: proud of you, plant parent redemption
Me: how's your grocery store basil doing lol
Maya: hanging in there, I actually remembered to put it by the window
Me: growth
Maya: btw did I tell you my sister looked up that pottery studio?
Me: oh nice! did she like it?
Maya: yeah she said the Tuesday guy sounds perfect for her schedule
Me: he's super chill, she'll love him
Maya: how'd your lopsided bowl turn out this week?
Me: even more lopsided but the glaze saved it kinda
Maya: that's art tho
Me: that's what I'm telling myself
Maya: save me a spot on that new patio if you get there first?
Me: yes I'll grab us a table, I wanna test those non-wobbly chairs
Maya: lol please do, I don't trust my balance today
Me: I'll get us water and hold down the fort
Maya: you're the best, I'll walk over right after I find this shoe
Me: take your time, I'm still gonna need like 20 mins to escape here
Maya: perfect, then my 5 mins late won't even matter
Me: exactly, we'll basically arrive at the same time
Maya: are you still doing salad + knots for balance?
Me: you know me so well, gotta pretend to be healthy
Maya: I'm going full pepperoni today, no regrets
Me: as you should
Maya: oh did they still have that lunch special you mentioned?
Me: I think so, I'll check the board when I'm there
Maya: cool, if not I'm still getting the usual
Me: same, garlic knots are non-negotiable
Maya: dangerous but necessary
Me: okay I should actually do a little work before I sneak out lol
Maya: yeah me too, let me put laundry in the dryer real quick
Me: good luck with the shoe hunt
Maya: thank you, if I'm still shoeless I'll just show up in slippers
Me: honestly that would be iconic", "writer_note": "Kept Maya's delay casual and preemptive to fit the 12:15-12:55 window before the 1pm meetup, with Me relaxed and holding the table so the plan stays on.
